description: Full-screen status/feedback page. Used for error, 404, not-found, offline, and success states.

icon.description: Large emoji or short symbol shown at the top — e.g. '✅', '⚠️', '404'

iconIsNumeral.description: Renders icon as a large numeral in primary color (e.g. for '404'). Default false.

detail.description: Small monospace detail line — e.g. 'Error ID: abc123'

actions.description: CTA buttons/links. First is primary by default.

footnote.description: Small footnote text/node below the action buttons
